people.name: Avinash Candra Kaviratna
people.note: Kavirāj in Calcutta; began publishing an English translation of the Caraka-Saṃhitā in 1890.

people.name: Pareshnath Sarma Kavibhushaṇa
people.note: Son of Avinash Candra Kaviratna; completed his father's translation of the Caraka-Saṃhitā in 1911.

relations.subject: Pareshnath Sarma Kavibhushaṇa
relations.evidence: nach dessen Tode (1905) von seinem Sohn Pareshnath Sarma Kavibhushaṇa fortgesetzt
